inline_visuals.prompt: A precise top-view educational diagram of a differential-drive robot with labeled left wheel speed v_L, right wheel speed v_R, wheel separation b, forward direction, and three adjacent motion cases: equal wheel arrows producing a straight path, a longer right-wheel arrow producing a path curving left, and equal opposite arrows producing rotation about the robot center. Use restrained textbook colors, clear arrows, minimal labels, white background, technically correct geometry.
inline_visuals.caption: Equal wheel speeds translate the robot; unequal speeds create a turn; opposite equal speeds create a spin.
inline_visuals.alt_text: Top-view differential-drive diagrams showing straight motion, left-turning motion, and spin in place.

inline_visuals.prompt: A clean engineering illustration showing RoboRover viewed from above as if it were a tray being pushed at two side wheels, with the right wheel traveling farther than the left and the robot body rotating counterclockwise toward a left-curving path. inline_visuals.caption: When the right wheel moves faster, it travels on the outside of the curve and RoboRover turns left.
inline_visuals.alt_text: Top-view engineering illustration of a differential-drive robot turning left because its right wheel is faster.
